fusions.name: Skims the Surface
fusions.desc: Throws a splash of water that deals 4 water damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: Throws water off you in a ring, dealing 11 water damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocking them back 2 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Dabbler's Calm

riders.text: your mana comes back faster while you stand on it
and you move over it faster than over ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
